A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a series of potent, selective and orally active inhibitors of HIF-1alpha proline hydroxylation.
the most effective 2-oxo acids are those that are able to form an enolate ion.
2-oxo acids with a hydrophobic side chain are good inhibitors of HIF poly hydroxylases, while those with an electron withdrawing substituent on the side chain are poor inhibitors.

the hydroxylases are not as sensitive to the structure of the cosubstrate as one would have expected.
